lines.text: Reggie the red rooster strutted on the barnyard fence, puffing out his glossy chest!
I have the loudest crow, the brightest feathers, and the highest jumps in town! he bragged!
Whenever his friends made great paintings or built castles, Reggie criticized them!
Nobody likes playing with someone who always insists they are better than everyone!
At the county fair race, Reggie tripped over his own big spurs and landed in mud!
Instead of laughing at him, his barnyard friends helped him up and cleaned his feathers!
Reggie blushed and realized true greatness means lifting others up with cheer!
Be humble, cheer for your teammates, and let your kindness speak for itself!
Cheer for your friends and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
